Still possible but unlikely. The lack of other athletic gear (mats, weights) and the strict adherence to a 05:30 start time on weekdays (which is unusual for athletes who might train later or vary intensity) keeps this low. The 'keys at 18:01' suggests a standard workday return rather than post-training errands.

Contradicted by the consistent 05:30 start time across all observed days (Mon-Wed), including weekends. Shift workers rarely maintain such precision. The 18:01 return also suggests a standard 9-5 or similar schedule, not irregular shifts.
